entries.title: Senior IS leader killed in joint operation, US and Nigeria say
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump said the operation eliminated "the most active terrorist in the world", Abu-Bilal al-Minuki.

entries.title: Trump warns Taiwan against declaring independence, hours after summit with China's Xi
entries.snippet: The US president says he wants Beijing and Taipei to "cool down" tensions over the self-governing island.

entries.title: Trump and Xi conclude 'very successful' talks but few deals confirmed
entries.snippet: There were plenty of choreographed ceremonies but no trade breakthroughs after the two-day visit.

entries.title: Switzerland to open secret files on Auschwitz 'Angel of Death' Mengele
entries.snippet: Mengele fled Europe after the war but for years there were rumours he spent time in Switzerland.

entries.title: Man killed by 13ft great white shark in Western Australia
entries.snippet: The man was bitten just before 10:00 (03:00 BST) at Horseshoe Reef - north-west of the popular Rottnest Island near the city of Perth, local police said.

entries.title: Lebanon says six killed in Israeli strike as US announces ceasefire extension
entries.snippet: President Trump announced the truce last month, but Israel and Hezbollah have continued to exchange fire since then.

entries.title: US planning to criminally indict ex-Cuban leader Raúl Castro
entries.snippet: Charges could come as soon as next week in a case reportedly focused on Cuba's downing of two planes in 1996.

entries.title: Freight train and bus crash kills at least eight in Bangkok
entries.snippet: Police and rescue officials said the collision sparked a fire that engulfed the bus.

entries.title: New outbreak of Ebola kills 80 in eastern DR Congo
entries.snippet: Africa's top health agency says around 246 cases have been reported - a case has also been reported in Uganda.

entries.title: Palestinian leaders hold rare party meeting as polls show rising discontent
entries.snippet: The Fatah faction elects top decision makers, but ordinary Palestinians feel the party and its leader are out of touch.

entries.title: Judge declares another mistrial in Harvey Weinstein New York rape case
entries.snippet: It marks the third time a New York jury has considered the case against the 74-year-old disgraced film mogul.

entries.title: Hamas confirms top commander killed in Israeli air strike
entries.snippet: Friday's strike is the latest launched by Israel on Gaza despite a ceasefire with Hamas.

entries.title: Trump says 20-year nuclear programme suspension by Iran would be enough
entries.snippet: The US president says Tehran has to show "real" commitment to removing nuclear fuel and stopping uranium enrichment.

entries.title: Prisoner swap goes ahead as Kyiv mourns 24 killed in Russian strike on flats
entries.snippet: Among the victims in Kyiv was 12-year-old Lyubava Yakovleva, whose father was killed during the war.

entries.title: Five Italians die during cave scuba dive in Maldives
entries.snippet: Four of the Italians were part of a team from the University of Genoa.

entries.title: New York Times defends journalist after Israel threatens to sue
entries.snippet: Israel's prime minister says he has ordered legal action over an article which alleged Israeli security officials raped Palestinian detainees.

entries.title: What China critics in Maga movement make of Trump's Beijing trip
entries.snippet: Trump’s softer approach towards China is one that experts say will likely trickle down to the wider MAGA base.

entries.title: What is a 'safe death'? Mentally ill woman asks for assisted dying in Canada
entries.snippet: Canada has twice delayed access to medically assisted dying for those with mental illness. Claire Brosseau says she cannot wait any longer and wants the courts to decide.

entries.title: From misfit to rap sensation: A 'Reble' storms into Indian hip-hop
entries.snippet: Reble has emerged as one of hip-hop’s most distinctive new voices, channelling defiance into a sound rooted in India’s northeast.

entries.title: Alleged murder of Aboriginal girl highlights Australia's deep inequalities
entries.snippet: Her death has sparked outrage across Australia and intense debate about disparities in society.

entries.title: Elephants eat their crops. Farmers strike back. It's a war that's only getting worse
entries.snippet: In Sri Lanka, the islanders revere elephants. But for farmers, there's rising tension that's leading to more fatal encounters — for both humans and hungry pachyderms.

entries.title: The townspeople of Vilseck, Germany, worry that Trump may pull out 5,000 U.S. troops
entries.snippet: President Trump's troop withdrawal threat rattles residents of a small Bavarian town reliant on U.S. military personnel and their families for both income and friendships built over decades.

entries.title: Colleges got more rural students to apply. The challenge is getting them to attend
entries.snippet: Some of the nation's most selective institutions are slowly increasing their rural enrollment with the help of millions of dollars from a rural alumnus of the University of Chicago.

entries.title: This Republican voted to convict Trump. Now he's up for reelection. Can he survive?
entries.snippet: Louisiana Sen. Bill Cassidy was one of seven Republican senators who voted to convict President Trump. Now he's running for reelection in a race that will test Trump's hold on the GOP.

entries.title: Trump says Islamic State group leader was killed in a joint U.S.-Nigerian mission
entries.snippet: Trump announced the joint operation in Africa's most populous country in a late-night social media post. He said Abu Bakr al-Mainuki was second in command of the Islamic State group globally.

entries.title: The Eurovision Song Contest reaches its grand final with pop and protests
entries.snippet: The final of the Eurovision Contest arrives Saturday, with tight security and rainy weather failing to dent the enthusiasm of fans, or the opposition of critics who think Israel shouldn't be invited.

entries.title: Israel says it killed the leader of Hamas' military wing
entries.snippet: Israel says it has killed the leader of Hamas' military wing, one of the architects of the Oct, 7, 2023, attacks that triggered the war in Gaza.

entries.title: Supreme Court is death knell for Virginia's Democratic-friendly congressional maps
entries.snippet: The new map was drawn by Democrats and approved by Virginia voters, but the state Supreme Court declared the referendum null and void because lawmakers failed to follow the proper procedures to get the issue on the ballot.

entries.title: Colorado's Democratic governor will let Trump ally Tina Peters out of prison early
entries.snippet: Gov. Jared Polis' controversial commutation follows a pressure campaign by the Trump administration to free Tina Peters, an ex-county official who was convicted of tampering with election equipment.

entries.title: Hantavirus countdown: U.S. cruise passengers settle in for 42 days of waiting
entries.snippet: The hantavirus outbreak on a cruise ship has potentially exposed passengers to a deadly disease. Most returning Americans are now housed in Nebraska. Some may be cleared to quarantine at home.

entries.title: Israel says it killed a top Hamas leader
entries.snippet: Izz al-Din al-Haddad, a leader of Hamas' military wing. He was one of the last surviving architects of the October 7, 2023, attacks that triggered the war in Gaza.

entries.title: Supreme Court rejects bid to restore Virginia congressional map favoring Democrats
entries.snippet: In recent days, the justices have sided with Republicans in Alabama and Louisiana who hope to redo their congressional maps to produce more GOP-leaning seats following the court's voting rights decision.

entries.title: Trump and Xi pledge 'strategic stability' but key questions remain unanswered
entries.snippet: President Trump is returning to Washington after a summit with Chinese leader Xi Jinping. The two sides announced they would launch a board of trade and investment, but beyond that, there are few specifics. Nick Schifrin reports from Beijing on the pageantry and the policy.

entries.title: Trump's 'elaborate' praise of Xi at China summit made U.S. look weak, ex-ambassador says
entries.snippet: For perspective on the summit between President Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping, Amna Nawaz spoke with Nicholas Burns. He served as U.S. ambassador to China during the Biden administration and is now at Harvard University.

entries.title: Live Results: Louisiana midterm state and congressional primaries
entries.snippet: Louisiana voters will participate in a revamped and stripped-down state primary Saturday and decide the political fate of an embattled Republican U.S. senator targeted for defeat by President Donald Trump.

entries.title: News Wrap: Colorado Gov. Polis commuting sentence of Tina Peters
entries.snippet: In our news wrap Friday, Colorado Gov. Jared Polis is commuting the prison sentence of 2020 election denier Tina Peters, the Justice Department announced the arrest of an Iraqi national accused of plotting at least 18 terror attacks in retaliation for the war in Iran and Africa's

entries.title: Jerome Powell's impact and legacy at the Federal Reserve
entries.snippet: Jerome Powell's eight-year role leading the Federal Reserve is over. His term will be remembered as one of the most turbulent and politically charged in the central bank's history. William Brangham discussed Powell's impact and legacy with Jason Furman.

entries.title: Primary challenge to Louisiana Sen. Cassidy tests Trump's grip on GOP
entries.snippet: Louisiana primary voters could boot a sitting U.S. senator for the first time in nearly 100 years. Backing the insurgency against Sen. Bill Cassidy is President Donald Trump. The pair have been at political odds since Cassidy voted to convict Trump in his second impeachment trial

entries.title: Trump administration prepares to seek Raúl Castro indictment as it pressures Cuba, AP sources say
entries.snippet: The Justice Department is preparing to seek an indictment against former Cuban President Raúl Castro, three people familiar with the matter told The Associated Press on Friday, as President Donald Trump threatens possible military action against the communist-run island.

entries.title: Brooks and Capehart on Trump's trip to China
entries.snippet: David Brooks of The Atlantic and Jonathan Capehart of MS NOW join Amna Nawaz to discuss the week in politics, including President Trump's trip to China, Congress rejecting a war powers resolution on the Iran war and Trump's comments on Americans' financial situation.

entries.title: How to recognize and block AI-powered scam attempts
entries.snippet: If it feels like it's getting harder and harder to avoid being scammed, that's because it is. In the age of artificial intelligence, scammers are using voice cloning that can sound very real, and seniors are often the target. Paul Solman reports on the problem and what you can do

entries.title: Colorado Gov. Polis commutes ex-election clerk Tina Peters' sentence after Trump pressure
entries.snippet: Trump has championed the case of Peters, a 70-year-old former county clerk who was sentenced to nine years behind bars after being convicted in a scheme to make a copy of her county's election computer system. She gets released June 1.

entries.title: Uganda confirms Ebola case in man from neighboring Congo who died in Ugandan capital
entries.snippet: Uganda on Friday reported one Ebola case involving a Congolese man admitted to a hospital in Kampala three days before he died. Officials said the case was "imported" from Congo, and that Uganda has not yet confirmed any local cases.

entries.title: Who is Tova Noel, a former prison guard testifying in the Epstein investigation
entries.snippet: Noel is one of two prison guards who were working on Aug. 9, 2019, the night before the financier was found dead in his cell.

entries.title: Judge declares mistrial in Harvey Weinstein's New York rape retrial after jury deadlocks
entries.snippet: The majority-male Manhattan jury had been weighing whether Weinstein raped Jessica Mann, a hairstylist and actor. Weinstein's lawyers argued that the encounter was consensual.

entries.title: Israel and Lebanon agree to 45-day extension of ceasefire, U.S. State Department says
entries.snippet: A shaky truce between Israel and the Hezbollah militant group in Lebanon had been due to end on Sunday.

entries.title: Tensions flare near Strait of Hormuz as one ship is seized and another is sunk
entries.snippet: It wasn't immediately clear who was behind these incidents, but they happened as a senior Iranian official reiterated his country's claim of control over the waterway and another said it had a right to seize oil tankers connected to the U.S.

entries.title: 6 passengers from hantavirus-hit cruise ship arrive in Australia for 3-week quarantine
entries.snippet: Australian Health Minister Mark Butler said the government would implement one of world's strongest quarantine responses to the outbreak.

entries.title: Takeaways from Fed chair Jerome Powell's legacy
entries.snippet: Federal Reserve Chair, Jerome Powell is stepping down after eight years. Here are key takeaways from his tenure.

entries.title: North America's largest commuter rail system faces a potential shutdown
entries.snippet: North America's largest commuter rail system is facing a potential shutdown as a deadline nears to reach a deal with unionized workers to avert a strike.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Taiwan urges Trump to advance arms deal after China summit
entries.snippet: Taiwan reminded the US of its commitment to provide it with arms after the US president warned the democratic, self-governing island against formally declaring independence in the wake of his summit with China's Xi.

entries.title: Several Gulf states are now using laser weapons to combat drones in the Iran war. But do they actually work?
entries.snippet: More Gulf states are turning to laser weapons to combat drones in the Iran war. Israel even loaned the UAE theirs. But do they actually work?

entries.title: Germany news: Nearly half the country wants governing conservative coalition out
entries.snippet: A survey has shown that just 30% of people in Germany want the coalition government to continue. Meanwhile, pro-Palestinian demonstrators are to hold a march in Berlin to mark Nakba Day. DW has more.

entries.title: Andreas Rettig: 'You can't separate sports and politics'
entries.snippet: The World Cup in the USA, Canada and Mexico is sparking discussions beyond the realm of football. DFB Director Andreas Rettig discusses the Germany team and the geopolitical situation in an interview with DW.

entries.title: Australia: Man dies after shark attack off holiday island
entries.snippet: A 38-year-old man has died after being bitten by a shark in waters off Rottnest Island in Western Australia. It is the second shark death in the country this year amid a rise in attacks.

entries.title: India news: PM Modi visits the Netherlands at start of Europe tour
entries.snippet: Modi is looking to deepen India's trade agreements with its European partners and diversify beyond China-centric supply chains. Meanwhile, Indian farmers are once again clashing with the police. Follow DW.

entries.title: Trump says IS second in command killed in Nigeria
entries.snippet: US President Donald Trump said Abu-Bilal al-Minuki, a high-ranking member of the "Islamic State," was killed in a joint mission between US and Nigerian forces.

entries.title: US stops Poland troop deployment after Germany pullout order
entries.snippet: Both Democratic and Republican lawmakers in the US have criticized the Trump administration's plans to cancel a troop deployment to Poland. It came after Trump ordered the pullout of 5,000 troops from Germany.

entries.title: Middle East: Israel, Lebanon agree to extend truce, US says
entries.snippet: The US says Israeli and Lebanese delegations have agreed to extend a ceasefire for 45 days. The truce has reduced the volume of fighting, but violations are commonplace, particularly in southern Lebanon.

entries.title: Germany news: Chancellor Merz says he wouldn't advise his kids to go to the US
entries.snippet: Chancellor Friedrich Merz said he wouldn't currently advise young Germans like his children to move to the US to study or work. He cited "the social climate that has suddenly developed."

entries.title: Islamic feminism more widespread in Bosnia and Herzegovina
entries.snippet: Many Bosnian Muslim women want to attend mosque on Fridays and to play a greater role in decision-making. Slowly the official structures of the Islamic Community are changing.

entries.title: Ukraine: Dozens of European countries sign up to special tribunal plan to prosecute Russia
entries.snippet: At talks in Moldova, more than 30 countries have said they will join a future special tribunal for Ukraine prosecuting Russia over its invasion. How the body will force Russians to stand trial is not clear.

entries.title: Pakistan faces pressure over mediator role in Iran war
entries.snippet: With Pakistan stepping in the middle of a major geopolitical conflict, Islamabad is forced to balance between Washington, Tehran, Beijing and key Gulf allies. A recent US media report places it under even more scrutiny.

entries.title: UK politics: How Starmer survives as Farage waits in wings
entries.snippet: High profile resignations, a prime minister on the edge and populists on the up — UK politics is far from dull. DW explains what's going on in Keir Starmer's Labour party and with Nigel Farage. And what may be next.

entries.title: US-China summit exposes Trump's limits on Iran war, Taiwan
entries.snippet: Donald Trump hopes to have China help him end the war in Iran, but this goal seemed far from guaranteed as he wrapped up his two-day visit to Beijing. Xi Jinping, in turn, took the chance to warn the US over Taiwan.

entries.title: Uganda at a crossroads as Museveni begins new term
entries.snippet: Unemployment and poverty pose major challenges for President Museveni's seventh term, while his age and long rule prompt questions about Uganda's future beyond his leadership.

entries.title: Israeli-Palestinian conflict: Allegations of sexual abuse
entries.snippet: The issue of systemic sexual abuses as part of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict is back in the spotlight following new testimonies. Both Israel and Hamas deny the claims.

entries.title: Iconic German musician Udo Lindenberg turns 80
entries.snippet: From a historic East German concert to a hit with rapper Apache 207, Udo Lindenberg has shaped German rock music like few others. Even at 80, the "Panikrocker" is still reinventing himself.

entries.title: Asteroid 2026 JH2 — no need to worry about it hitting Earth
entries.snippet: This big asteroid was discovered less than a fortnight before its flyby Earth. But any time you see a headline about asteroids flying by the planet, you can relax. Big and small asteroids fly by Earth all the time.
